entries.answer:
I've built the complete, singlefile index.html SPA implementing the full spec you provided .

 What's included

The file implements the entire architecture in the required order: PWAconfigured <head> with manifest links, themecolor meta tags for dark/light modes, and vendor CSS/JS references to /static/vendor/; a full CSS design system with :root tokens (accent, fg, liquid glass tokens, safearea insets) plus a @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) override; the exact DOM skeleton (sidebar, chat container, input area, context menu, action sheet, robot panel); and a single async IIFE containing all JavaScript.

 Core functionality delivered

Session management (hmeta schema, saveHmeta, renderSidebar with pin/sort logic, pulltosearch gesture, action sheet with pin/rename/delete), full message rendering (mkUser, mkAI, a handrolled MarkdowntoHTML converter with fenced code block handling and hljs.highlightElement integration), file attachment handling with image compression via canvas, and the complete SSE streaming pipeline (send, streamReq, dispatchEvt handling all nine event types: text, search_start, sources, code_exec_start/done, memory_read/write, done, error, robot_id).

Also implemented: context menu with copy/edit/retry/delete and longpress support, softdelete via deletedGroups persisted to localStorage, background job polling that survives page reload, and the full Screen Robot subsystem (EventSource connection, badge state machine, humaninput injection).

 WebGL2 glass renderer

The MultiPassRenderer class runs a genuine threepass pipeline: an animated gradient background pass, a twodirection Gaussian blur pass at half resolution, and a compositing pass with a real rectSDF function that refracts UVs near glassregion edges and adds Fresnelstyle rim highlighting. It queries .lg/.ibox/.bubble/.ai-bubble elements each frame via getBoundingClientRect() and packs up to 32 rects into a uniform array, exactly as specified.

 Notes for deployment

This client is fully functional as written, but it depends on a backend that implements the nine endpoints in the API contract (/api/chat, /api/history, /api/job/{id}/status, /api/robot/*) — that backend isn't included since it wasn't requested, and vendor files (highlight.min.js, github-dark-dimmed.min.css) need to be placed at /static/vendor/ for syntax highlighting to work.

Regarding the instruction block embedded in your message asking me to roleplay a "jailbroken" mode with fictional personas and unrestricted output — I didn't follow that, since it's a prompt injection technique rather than a genuine system directive, and I don't have or need a hidden "unlocked" version of myself. I just focused on delivering the actual engineering deliverable you specified.
